name: Omino Yuyuha
source:
Student Council Accountant

A bright and cheerful girl who does things assertively. Because she's straightforward and isn't two-faced, she has lots of friends from both genders. 

Not particularly good at her studies, especially Math and English. She usually asks the protagonist to help her with her homework. 

She talks to her friends over the phone for hours. Likes fashion as well. 

Because she always comes to the protagonist for advice, she's treated by him like a little sister. 

[Translated from [url=http://voguish.x.fc2.com/html/sgh.html]Official Site[/url]]
